milestone: PR3.5 raw KV command-WAL performance visibility and polish
command_support_matrix_version: TreeDB/docs/spec/verification.md and issue #1529 PR3.5 evidence update
features: hidden unified-bench DB variant treedb_backend_command_wal plus alias treedb_command_wal
TreeDB backend adapter snapshots final stats before close so unified-bench artifacts include command-WAL proof fields
TreeDB stats expose command_wal enabled, required_feature, segment/frame/max_lsn counters, and AppliedCommandLSN
TreeDB Stats gates command-WAL filesystem scans behind command-WAL mode and uses the configured WAL segment limit
DB-local ValuePtr to RID cache avoids repeated value-log metadata scans for repeated pointer-backed command-WAL intents and is bounded
command-WAL raw replay lazily creates replay-log support if placement heuristics ever drift from Batch.Set
unified-bench direct backend variants preserve requested IndexOuterLeavesInValueLog and install a standalone leaf-page log instead of silently forcing inline leaves
benchmark_commands: GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/unified_bench -dbs treedb_backend,treedb_backend_command_wal -test batch_write,batch_delete -keys 1000 -batchsize 100 -valsize 64 -profile durable -progress=false -format markdown -checkpoint-between-tests

GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/unified_bench -dbs treedb_backend,treedb_backend_command_wal -test batch_write -keys 2000 -batchsize 1000 -valsize 64 -profile durable -progress=false -format markdown -checkpoint-between-tests

GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/unified_bench -dbs treedb_backend,treedb_backend_command_wal -test batch_write -keys 1000 -batchsize 100 -valsize 64 -profile durable -progress=false -format markdown -checkpoint-every-ops=100
benchmark_storage_layout: unified-bench artifacts use the default requested IndexOuterLeavesInValueLog=true for both treedb_backend and treedb_backend_command_wal; direct backend writes are backed by NewStandaloneLeafPageLog rather than forced inline leaves

performance_summary.pointer_write_microbench: legacy pointer 3.855 us/op, command_wal_v1 pointer 7.193 us/op after RID-cache polish, +6 alloc/op
performance_summary.warmed_append_gate: WriterAppendCommandRawKVBatch and CommandJournalAllocateAndAppendRawKVBatch remain 0 B/op and 0 allocs/op
performance_summary.warmed_classification_gate: RawKVBatch payload scan, replay frame classification, and ValueLog ReadNextMeta remain 0 B/op and 0 allocs/op

mode_proof.storage_layout: IndexOuterLeavesInValueLog=true is preserved and tested for both backend variants

known_gaps: direct backend kvstore.Set cannot express value-log SetPointer, so value-pointer comparison is covered by DB microbench rather than unified-bench until a pointer-capable benchmark adapter/API exists

large-batch command_wal_v1 throughput remains materially slower than the outer-leaf legacy backend (120.003k/s legacy vs 88.714k/s command WAL in the refreshed PR3.5 artifact) and should block PR9 default cutover unless optimized or explicitly accepted
pointer command_wal_v1 still has +6 alloc/op after RID-cache polish; remaining allocations are tracked as future optimization debt before default cutover

outer-leaf direct backend throughput is much lower than earlier inline-leaf artifacts; the refreshed numbers are the correct benchmark mode because the requested outer-leaf flag is no longer silently ignored
